answer: If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a harbor counter-signature, and the willow graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 36% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, logged as a delta edge. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
